patches.name: Bhitarkanika Core
patches.notes: Bhitarkanika Core ranks #12 of 16 by criticality (S = 0.051): removing it lowers IIC by 5.1%. It holds 665.0 ha, 8.2% of mapped habitat (#5 by area). It is large but structurally redundant: other patches carry its links. It is isolated (degree 0), so its loss removes only its own area. Segmentation confidence for this patch is 90%.

patches.name: Dangmal Block
patches.notes: Dangmal Block ranks #6 of 16 by criticality (S = 0.087): removing it lowers IIC by 8.7%. It holds 345.2 ha, 4.2% of mapped habitat (#11 by area).
